name: Dual-Port Memory & Synchronization Architecture
aliases: SSC San Diego Volumetric Control Card
definition: A dual-port RAM architecture that stores 2D image points and synchronizes their readout to a rotating helix or reciprocating piston, transforming 2D points into 3D voxels based on surface position at readout time.
summary: This hardware interface synchronizes memory readout with mechanical display motion to map 2D points to 3D voxels, differing from static layout methods by using external signals for spatial mapping.
